build_AutoEncoder: build a Mesh VAE autoencoder with encoder, decoder, shadow net, and renderer for 3D human mesh reconstruction
create_Encoder: create a joint convolutional VAE encoder that produces learnable embeddings from unposed mesh UV coordinates
create_FaceEncoder: create a face-specific encoder that crops and encodes the face region of unposed mesh UV coordinates
create_ConvDecoder: create a convolutional decoder that reconstructs geometry deltas and texture from pose and learned embeddings
create_CameraPixelBias: create a per-camera learnable pixel bias module that interpolates downsampled bias maps to full resolution
